    """Complete the border of the marker cells' bounding box: fill border gaps with the fill color, keep markers, interior unchanged."""
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if grid[i][j]==marker]
    rs=[i for i,_ in cells]; cs=[j for _,j in cells]
